## Plugin reference

- Description: The mise toolchain as an updater: contributes `mise` to the updater registry, so the Dependency upgrades automation includes it in the batched upgrade task and `./singularity deps upgrade mise` (alias: `toolchain upgrade`) moves mise.lock through the gated runner.
